entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6239410080231903488: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.8733 +/- 0.0465 mas (same row, RUWE 1.11): 112.70 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -0.355, -64.712 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.379 +/- 0.003 solar radii from Castro González et al. 2020, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-316 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020MNRAS.499.5416C/abstract). Mass 0.408 +/- 0.005 solar masses from Castro González et al. 2020, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-316 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020MNRAS.499.5416C/abstract). Temperature 3436 +/- 3 K from Castro González et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-316 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,436 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffc588. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret (2017), A&A 600, A30 computes from PHOENIX model atmospheres for the TESS band at 3,436 K and log g 4.89 (u1 0.164, u2 0.439): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
